draft.body: Siloed credit is a liquidation trap. With Gearbox, a flash wick in one account wipes you out—even if your other account is over-collateralized. Vanna unifies margin under one health factor. Your idle assets actively back your risk. Leverage is easy. Staying alive is hard.
